Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a commercially driven and digitally fluent Marketing & Media Manager to lead digital & paid media delivery across multiple markets out of our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.
The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, has deep expertise in paid media and digital performance marketing, and understands the nuances of luxury consumer behaviour across diverse global audiences.

Your Impact

1.    Local Media / Marketing Leadership
•    Depending on the size and staffing of the markets in your scope, act as either the local digital media lead, local media lead or local marketing lead.
•    Ensure media campaigns drive brand strategy and align with global standards, while  reflecting local audience behaviour, seasonal demand patterns, language requirements, and cultural nuances.
•    Partner with local sales and marketing teams to support market-specific business and commercial objectives, and with global marketing and media teams to ensure strategic and executional brand consistency.

2.    Digital Campaign Delivery
•    Lead the end-to-end delivery of digital marketing campaigns across multiple markets, ensuring timely execution, consistency, with all placements and asset adaptations meeting luxury brand standards
•    Coordinate with creative, content, CRM, ecommerce, and digital teams to ensure seamless campaign integration and customer journey alignment.

3.    Paid Media Strategy & Performance
•    Develop & execute local paid media strategies across multiple markets.
•    Manage local agency, platforms and media partner relationships.

4.    Measurement & performance analysis

Own the integrated measurement of media across the marketing funnel. Monitor and analyse performance and optimize investments to drive brand awareness, revenue growth, customer acquisition, and direct bookings, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement, including reports and presentations for senior leadership.

5.    Media thought leadership & innovation

Own the innovation plan across channels. Identify the latest media industry developments, recommending test & learn plans to integrate the relevant areas to Explora journey’s media strategy.

6.    Build media literacy

Step-change media knowledge in markets across departments to enhance media planning capabilities and excellence in delivery.

7.    Budget management

Own the global media budget planning, spending and stewardship, including agency/vendor management

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

- 15+ years of client side roles in global and local media including planning, ATL/BTL and directly running digital media.

- Outstanding luxury media understanding: in-depth knowledge of offline and digital media, the interdependencies between paid, owned and earned media, as well as luxury media specifics.

- Proven ability to roll-up your sleeves and execute with excellence

- Track record of managing agencies, platforms and media partners and building effective partnerships

Your Essentials

- Strategic and innovative critical thinker.

- Structured, well organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects, thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment.

- Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to navigate a matrix organisation. Effectively organize teams to deliver business outcomes.

- Proven analytical skills with proficiency in media tools and platforms

- Strong preference for prior experience in the luxury or luxury hospitality/travel industry. A personal passion for luxury travel and global mindset.

- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving media industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario.

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Esiste un'opportunità entusiasmante per un Marketing & Media Manager commercialmente guidato e digitalmente fluente per condurre la consegna dei media digitali e pagati su più mercati fuori dai nostri uffici a Ginevra, Svizzera.
Il candidato ideale combina il pensiero strategico con l'eccellenza operativa, ha una profonda competenza nei media retribuiti e nel marketing delle prestazioni digitali, e comprende le sfumature del comportamento dei consumatori di lusso in un pubblico globale diverso.

Il tuo impatto

1.    Leadership dei media locali / Marketing
•    A seconda delle dimensioni e del personale dei mercati nel vostro campo di applicazione, agire come sia il piombo digitale locale media, piombo media locale o piombo di marketing locale.
•    Assicurarsi che le campagne multimediali guidino la strategia del marchio e si allineino agli standard globali, riflettendo il comportamento del pubblico locale, i modelli di domanda stagionale, i requisiti linguistici e le sfumature culturali.
•    Collabora con i team di vendita e marketing locali per supportare obiettivi commerciali e commerciali specifici sul mercato, e con i team di marketing e media globali per garantire la coerenza strategica ed esecutiva del marchio.

2.    Consegna della campagna digitale
•    Condurre la consegna end-to-end di campagne di marketing digitale su più mercati, assicurando l'esecuzione tempestiva, la coerenza, con tutti i posizionamenti e gli adattamenti patrimoniali che soddisfano gli standard del marchio di lusso
•    Coordinate con team creativi, contenuti, CRM, ecommerce e digitali per garantire l'integrazione della campagna senza soluzione di continuità e l'allineamento del percorso del cliente.

3.    Strategia e prestazioni dei media a pagamento
•    Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie multimediali a pagamento locali su più mercati.
•    Gestisci le relazioni di agenzia locale, piattaforme e partner media.

4.    Analisi delle misurazioni e delle prestazioni

Possedere la misura integrata dei media attraverso l'imbuto di marketing. Monitorare e analizzare le prestazioni e ottimizzare gli investimenti per guidare la consapevolezza del marchio, la crescita dei ricavi, l'acquisizione dei clienti e le prenotazioni dirette, fornendo approfondimenti e raccomandazioni per il miglioramento continuo, inclusi report e presentazioni per la leadership senior.

5.    Leader & innovazione dei media

Proprio il piano di innovazione attraverso i canali. Identificare gli ultimi sviluppi del settore dei media, raccomandando test e imparare i piani per integrare le aree rilevanti per la strategia dei media di Explora.

6.    Costruisci l'alfabetizzazione dei media

Scambio della conoscenza dei media nei mercati attraverso i dipartimenti per migliorare le capacità di pianificazione dei media e l'eccellenza nella consegna.

7.    Gestione del bilancio

Possedere la pianificazione, la spesa e la gestione del budget dei media globali, compresa la gestione dell'agenzia/vendor

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Corso di laurea o master

- 15+ anni di ruoli lato client nei media globali e locali, tra cui la pianificazione, ATL/BTL e direttamente in esecuzione dei media digitali.

- Eccellente comprensione dei media di lusso: conoscenza approfondita dei media offline e digitali, le interdipendenze tra i media pagati, di proprietà e guadagnati, così come le specifiche dei media di lusso.

- Prove capacità di roll-up le maniche ed eseguire con eccellenza

- Tracciare il record di agenzie di gestione, piattaforme e partner multimediali e costruire partnership efficaci

I tuoi essenziali

- Pensatore critico strategico e innovativo.

- Strutturato, ben organizzato, orientato ai dettagli, e in grado di gestire più progetti, prosperando in un ambiente di avvio veloce e veloce.

- Collaborazione eccezionale e capacità di influenzare, con comprovata capacità di navigare in un'organizzazione di matrice. Efficacemente organizzare i team per fornire risultati aziendali.

- Prove competenze analitiche con competenza in strumenti e piattaforme multimediali

- Forte preferenza per esperienza precedente nel settore lusso o lusso ospitalità / viaggio. Una passione personale per i viaggi di lusso e la mentalità globale.

- Ottima capacità di comunicazione, sia scritta che verbale. Fluente in inglese.

- Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente l'industria dei media in continua evoluzione.

A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia.
Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare.
Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

Wo Leidenschaft auf Chance trifft

Entdecken Sie Ihre Reise ins Außergewöhnliche.

Dein Zweck

Explora Journeys ist eine lebendige, kosmopolitische, europäische Luxusmarke, die im Herzen der Schweizer Gastfreundschaft in Genf vorgestellt wird. Durch die Nutzung der hundertjährigen maritimen Expertise unserer Muttergesellschaft MSC Group wird unsere Flotte von sechs Luxusschiffen (vier derzeit in der Pipeline) auf eine völlig andere und einzigartige Weise gebaut und entworfen, die das Kreuzfahrterlebnis verändern und neu definieren und eine eigene Kategorie schaffen wird, die die nächste Generation von Luxusreisenden anspricht.

Eine aufregende Gelegenheit besteht für einen kommerziell orientierten und digital fließenden Marketing & Media Manager, die Bereitstellung digitaler und bezahlter Medien in mehreren Märkten von unseren Büros in Genf, Schweiz, aus zu leiten.
Der ideale Kandidat kombiniert strategisches Denken mit operativer Exzellenz, verfügt über fundiertes Fachwissen im Bereich Paid Media und Digital Performance Marketing und versteht die Nuancen des Luxuskonsumverhaltens bei verschiedenen globalen Zielgruppen.

Ihre Wirkung

1.    Lokale Medien / Marketing Leadership
•    Abhängig von der Größe und der Besetzung der Märkte in Ihrem Bereich, handeln Sie entweder als lokaler Digital Media Lead, lokaler Media Lead oder lokaler Marketing Lead.
•    Stellen Sie sicher, dass Medienkampagnen die Markenstrategie vorantreiben und sich an globalen Standards orientieren, während sie das lokale Publikumsverhalten, saisonale Nachfragemuster, Sprachanforderungen und kulturelle Nuancen widerspiegeln.
•    Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Vertriebs- und Marketingteams zur Unterstützung marktspezifischer Geschäfts- und Geschäftsziele sowie mit globalen Marketing- und Medienteams zur Gewährleistung strategischer und exekutiver Markenkonsistenz.

2.    Digital Campaign Delivery
•    Führen Sie die End-to-End-Bereitstellung digitaler Marketingkampagnen über mehrere Märkte hinweg und gewährleisten Sie eine zeitnahe Ausführung, Konsistenz, wobei alle Platzierungen und Asset-Anpassungen den Luxusmarkenstandards entsprechen
•    Koordinieren Sie sich mit Kreativ-, Content-, CRM-, E-Commerce- und digitalen Teams, um eine nahtlose Kampagnenintegration und Kundenreise-Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten.

3.    Paid Media Strategie und Performance
•    Entwickeln und implementieren Sie lokale Paid Media Strategien in mehreren Märkten.
•    Verwalten Sie lokale Agenturen, Plattformen und Medienpartnerbeziehungen.

4.    Messung und Leistungsanalyse

Besitzen Sie die integrierte Messung von Medien über den Marketing-Trichter. Überwachen und analysieren Sie die Leistung und optimieren Sie die Investitionen, um die Markenbekanntheit, das Umsatzwachstum, die Kundenakquisition und Direktbuchungen zu fördern, indem Sie Einblicke und Empfehlungen für kontinuierliche Verbesserungen liefern, einschließlich Berichten und Präsentationen für Führungskräfte.

5.    Media Thought Leadership & Innovation

Besitzen Sie den Innovationsplan über alle Kanäle hinweg. Identifizieren Sie die neuesten Entwicklungen in der Medienbranche und empfehlen Sie Test- & Lernpläne zur Integration der relevanten Bereiche in die Medienstrategie von Explora Journey.

6.    Medienkompetenz aufbauen

Ändern Sie das Medienwissen in abteilungsübergreifenden Märkten, um die Fähigkeiten der Medienplanung und die Exzellenz bei der Bereitstellung zu verbessern.

7.    Haushaltsführung

Eigentümer der globalen Medienbudgetplanung, -ausgaben und -verantwortung, einschließlich Agentur- / Verkäufermanagement

Deine Reise bisher

- Bachelor- oder Masterstudium

- 15+ Jahre als Kunde in globalen und lokalen Medien, einschließlich Planung, ATL/BTL und direkter Ausführung digitaler Medien.

- Herausragendes Verständnis von Luxusmedien: fundierte Kenntnisse der Offline- und digitalen Medien, der Interdependenzen zwischen Paid, Owned und Earned Media sowie der Besonderheiten von Luxusmedien.

- Bewährte Fähigkeit, Ihre Ärmel aufzurollen und mit Exzellenz auszuführen

- Erfolgsbilanz von Verwaltungsagenturen, Plattformen und Medienpartnern und Aufbau effektiver Partnerschaften

Ihre Essentials

- Strategische und innovative kritische Denker.

- Strukturiert, gut organisiert, detailorientiert und in der Lage, mehrere Projekte zu verwalten, die in einer schnelllebigen Start-up-Umgebung gedeihen.

- Hervorragende Zusammenarbeit und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten, mit nachgewiesener Fähigkeit, eine Matrixorganisation zu navigieren. Organisieren Sie effektiv Teams, um Geschäftsergebnisse zu liefern.

- Nachgewiesene analytische Fähigkeiten mit Kenntnissen in Medien-Tools und Plattformen

- Starke Präferenz für frühere Erfahrungen in der Luxus- oder Luxus-Hospitality / Reisebranche. Eine persönliche Leidenschaft für Luxusreisen und globale Denkweise.

- Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl schriftlich als auch verbal. fließend in Englisch.

- Leidenschaft und Neugier, sich kontinuierlich über die sich ständig weiterentwickelnde Medienbranche zu informieren.

Bei Explora Journeys definieren wir Luxus-Ozeanreisen neu - wo Entdeckung, Wohlbefinden und ein tiefer Respekt für die Meere in Harmonie zusammenkommen.
Wir suchen leidenschaftliche Profis, die unsere Vision von einer immersiveren, transformativeren Art und Weise teilen, die inspirierendsten Reiseziele der Welt auf dem Seeweg zu entdecken.
Bist du bereit, deine Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf Explora Journeys, wo ein Ozean von Möglichkeiten wartet. Ihre Reise zum Ocean State of Mind beginnt hier.

Où la passion rencontre des opportunités

Découvrez votre voyage dans l'extraordinaire.

Votre but

Explora Journeys est une marque de luxe européenne dynamique et cosmopolite, imaginée au cœur de l'hospitalité suisse à Genève. Tirant parti de notre société mère MSC Group de centaines d'années d'expertise maritime, notre flotte de six navires de luxe (quatre actuellement dans le pipeline) sont en cours de construction et de conception d'une manière totalement différente et unique qui transformera et redéfinira l'expérience de croisière, créant une catégorie propre, attrayant pour la prochaine génération de voyageurs de luxe.

Une opportunité passionnante s'offre à un responsable marketing et médias, dynamique et numérique, de diriger la distribution numérique et payante des médias sur plusieurs marchés de nos bureaux à Genève, en Suisse.
Le candidat idéal combine la pensée stratégique et l'excellence opérationnelle, possède une expertise approfondie dans les médias payants et le marketing de performance numérique, et comprend les nuances du comportement des consommateurs de luxe dans divers publics mondiaux.

Votre impact

1.    Médias locaux / Leadership en marketing
•    Selon la taille et l'effectif des marchés dans votre domaine, agir en tant que chef de file des médias numériques locaux, chef de file des médias locaux ou chef de file du marketing local.
•    Veiller à ce que les campagnes médiatiques orientent la stratégie de la marque et s'harmonisent avec les normes mondiales, tout en reflétant le comportement de l'auditoire local, les tendances saisonnières de la demande, les exigences linguistiques et les nuances culturelles.
•    Partenaire avec des équipes locales de vente et de marketing pour soutenir des objectifs commerciaux et commerciaux spécifiques au marché, et avec des équipes mondiales de marketing et de médias pour assurer la cohérence stratégique et exécutionnelle de la marque.

2.    Campagne numérique
•    Diriger la livraison de bout en bout de campagnes de marketing numérique sur plusieurs marchés, en assurant l'exécution en temps opportun, la cohérence, avec tous les placements et adaptations d'actifs conformes aux normes de la marque de luxe
•    Coordonner avec des équipes créatives, de contenu, de CRM, de commerce électronique et numériques pour assurer une intégration de campagne transparente et l'alignement du parcours client.

3.    Stratégie et rendement des médias payants
•    Développer et exécuter des stratégies locales de médias payants sur plusieurs marchés.
•    Gérer les agences locales, les plateformes et les relations avec les médias partenaires.

4.    Mesure et analyse des performances

Posséder la mesure intégrée des médias à travers l'entonnoir de marketing. Surveiller et analyser les performances et optimiser les investissements pour stimuler la sensibilisation à la marque, la croissance des revenus, l'acquisition de clients et les réservations directes, en fournissant des idées et des recommandations pour l'amélioration continue, y compris des rapports et des présentations pour les cadres supérieurs.

5.    Leadership de la pensée médiatique & innovation

Posséder le plan d'innovation à travers les canaux. Identifier les derniers développements de l'industrie des médias, en recommandant des plans de test et d'apprentissage pour intégrer les domaines pertinents à Explora voyage.

6.    Renforcer la connaissance des médias

Faire évoluer les connaissances sur les médias dans les marchés d'un ministère à l'autre afin d'améliorer les capacités de planification des médias et l'excellence de leur prestation.

7.    Gestion budgétaire

Posséder le budget mondial des médias planification, dépenses et gérance, y compris la gestion des agences/vendors

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise

- 15 ans et plus de rôles côté client dans les médias mondiaux et locaux, y compris la planification, ATL/BTL et la gestion directe des médias numériques.

- Compréhension des médias de luxe exceptionnelle : connaissance approfondie des médias hors ligne et numériques, interdépendance entre les médias payés, possédés et gagnés, ainsi que les spécificités des médias de luxe.

- Capacité éprouvée de rouler vos manches et d'exécuter avec excellence

- Suivi des agences de gestion, des plateformes et des partenaires médiatiques et établissement de partenariats efficaces

Vos essentiels

- Penseur critique stratégique et innovant.

- Structurel, bien organisé, axé sur le détail et capable de gérer plusieurs projets, prospère dans un environnement de démarrage rapide.

- Excellente collaboration et influence des compétences, avec une capacité éprouvée de naviguer dans une organisation matricielle. Organiser efficacement des équipes pour obtenir des résultats opérationnels.

- Compétences analytiques éprouvées en matière d'outils et de plateformes médiatiques

- Une forte préférence pour une expérience antérieure dans l'industrie du luxe ou de l'hôtellerie/voyage. Une passion personnelle pour les voyages de luxe et l'état d'esprit global.

- Excellente capacité de communication, à la fois écrite et verbale. En anglais.

- Passion et curiosité d'apprendre continuellement sur l'industrie des médias en constante évolution.

À Explora Journeys, nous redéfinissons le voyage maritime de luxe, où la découverte, le bien-être et le profond respect des mers s'unissent en harmonie.
Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés qui partagent notre vision d'une façon plus immersive et transformatrice de découvrir les destinations les plus inspirantes du monde par la mer.
Êtes-vous prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous à Explora Journeys, où un océan d'opportunités vous attend. Votre voyage vers l'état de l'océan commence ici.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

Part of the global Marketing team and reporting directly to the Brand Director, this role plays a central role in safeguarding, shaping and activating the Explora Journeys brand across all touchpoints, with a particular focus on brand campaigns, the fleet and new brand developments.

Based at our headquarters in Geneva, this role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, product storytelling, and execution, working closely with Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media, and Digital teams to bring the brand to life with clarity, consistency and emotional depth, across markets.

Your Impact

Brand Management & Governance

- Act as a core guardian of the Explora Journeys brand, supporting the Brand Director in the day to day management, development, and evolution of the brand.

- Ensure consistent application of brand identity, tone of voice, messaging, and visual language across all touchpoints, channels, and guest journeys.

- Lead the development, evolution and maintenance of brand guidelines, frameworks, and master toolkits, ensuring relevance, clarity, and scalability globally.

- Monitor brand execution across markets and partners, proactively identifying inconsistencies and working collaboratively with stakeholders to safeguard luxury and hospitality standards.

- Contribute to brand strategy initiatives, brand evolution projects, and internal brand education, strengthening brand understanding and alignment across the organisation.

Campaigns, Content & Brand Activation

- Lead the development and delivery of master brand and product campaigns, in line with brand strategy and commercial priorities.

- Oversee the creation of hero brand and product assets, including key visuals, copy frameworks, brochures, photography, and videography.

- Work closely with Media, Digital, and PR teams to ensure a coherent  and premium brand expression across paid, owned, and earned channels.

- Manage and curate brand, product and fleet content within DAM and PIM systems, ensuring accuracy, ease of use and global market adoption.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

• Führen Sie fortschrittliche digitale Segmentierungsanalysen durch, um hochwertige Kundensegmente und Personalisierungsmöglichkeiten im gesamten Conversion Funnel aufzudecken.

Your Purpose

We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated Mobile App Product Specialist to join our Business Innovation team at MSC Cruises Headquarters in Geneva. This role is designed for a data-driven professional with a strong commercial acumen, an analytical mindset, and a passion for optimizing mobile user journeys. The successful candidate will explore in-app behaviors, remove friction in the sales funnel, and drive product-led initiatives to maximize conversion rates and shape the future of digital guest experiences across the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

Your Impact

- Analyze the MSC for Me in-app user journey and behavior to identify bottlenecks, proposing and validating product initiatives that optimize the sales funnel and boost in-app conversion rates.

- Collaborate with Product, Tech, and UX/UI cross-functional teams to design and implement features that drive organic user acquisition and increase cross-selling/up-selling opportunities for the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Implement and optimize the in-app position of commercial offerings (working closing with Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) to maximize visibility and sales conversions specifically for mobile users.

- Use advanced product analytics tools and data visualization (Power BI) to track sales performance, user activation rates, and drop-offs into the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Act as a bridge between the Onboard Revenues Commercial department and the Tech/Development teams, translating revenue goals into clear digital product requirements to enhance the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Drive MSC for Me  channel-led acquisition by refining native in-app features—such as frictionless guest-to-registered user flows, invite-a-friend mechanisms, and seamless app sharing—to grow the user base.

- Conduct A/B testing on MSC for Me  in-app sales flows, checkout processes, and subscription models to continuously improve operational efficiency and revenue generation.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing Management, Digital or a related field.

- Strong commercial and analytical skills with 3 to 5 years of proven experience in digital sales, product growth, or digital business development, with a strict focus on mobile applications.

- Hands-on experience with app analytics, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and data manipulation/visualization tools (Power BI, SQL; Python is a plus).

- Familiarity with agile methodologies and ability to work side-by-side with developers and product managers in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate data-driven insights into actionable business and product recommendations.

- Creative thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving, capable of driving "Product-Led Growth" rather than relying on traditional marketing spend.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of mobile user behavior, digital sales funnels, and product-centric acquisition ecosystems.

- Strong business acumen with a focus on maximizing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and removing friction from the mobile buying experience.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Junior Architect supports the Port Development team through fast and accurate production of conceptual and technical drawings.
The role is focused on internal execution: transforming design inputs into conceptual documentation and effective visualizations to support decision-making across private destinations, cruise terminals, port infrastructure and related facilities.

Your Impact

- Support the translation of business and design inputs into zoning studies, basic spatial diagrams, and architectural layouts.

- Assist in the development of preliminary layouts following internal design guidance and operational requirements.

- Prepare early stage conceptual design packages for internal review and coordination.

- Produce presentation decks, diagrams, visual narratives, and material boards to support internal communication.

- Develop mandatory 3D models and real time visualizations to support internal reviews and executive level presentations.

- Rapidly update, correct, and revise architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, layouts, façade studies, and circulation diagrams.

- Adapt and coordinate port and civil drawings, including site layouts, infrastructure interfaces, circulation roads, and hardscape coordination.

Your Journey so far

- Strong passion for architecture and the world of interiors, materials and spatial composition.

- Curious and design-oriented, with attention to proportion, atmosphere and detail.

- Execution-driven and highly operational.

- Fast in drawing production and revisions.

- Detail-oriented and structured.

- Comfortable working under tight timelines in a dynamic development environment.

Your Essentials

- Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with strong drafting speed and precision.

- Strong 3D modeling capabilities in SketchUp or Revit (SketchUp preferred).

- Mandatory experience with real-time rendering tools (Enscape, Twinmotion or equivalent).

- Good knowledge of Photoshop for post-production and corrections.

- Basic knowledge of (or interest in) AI tools such as Stable Diffusion or Magnific AI.

- The ability to independently produce clear, standard-quality visualizations for internal decision-making.

- Portfolio including technical drawings and rendered visualizations to be shared with the CV.

The Junior Architect Port Development Intern must be enrolled in a study program requiring a valid internship agreement. Candidates must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland. Full professional proficiency in English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.

Your Purpose

The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only.
The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization.
For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction.
For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles.
Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations.

Your Impact

Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore)

- Define and implement the global Learning & Development strategy covering both shipboard crew and shore-based employees.

- Develop an integrated learning ecosystem that supports operational excellence onboard and leadership capability ashore.

- Ensure learning initiatives directly support strategic priorities such as:

- guest experience excellence

- safety and compliance

- operational performance

- leadership effectiveness

- digital and business transformation

- Oversee onboarding and development frameworks to accelerate employee integration and performance across both shipboard and shore environments.

- Lead the adoption of modern learning approaches including digital learning, simulation-based training, microlearning, and blended learning solutions.

Shipboard Learning & Development

- Lead the design and delivery of the global shipboard learning and development strategy across the fleet.

- Partner closely with Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, and Guest Experience leadership to ensure training programs support operational priorities and service excellence.

- Ensure consistent training standards across the fleet while accommodating the operational realities of shipboard environments.

- Oversee development programs for key shipboard roles, including supervisory and management development programs for future onboard leaders.

- Support structured career development pathways for shipboard crew, enabling internal progression across hospitality and operational functions.

- Ensure alignment with all maritime regulatory training requirements and safety standards.

Shore-Based Learning & Development

- Lead the design and implementation of learning and development programs for shore-based employees across corporate and operational functions.

- Develop capability-building initiatives supporting key business priorities such as:

- commercial capabilities

- digital transformation

- operational excellence

- guest-centric culture

- Design structured leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders.

- Develop functional academies and capability frameworks supporting critical corporate disciplines.

Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only)

- Define and implement the company’s global talent management strategy for shore-based employees.

- Lead processes for:

- talent identification and talent reviews

- succession planning for critical leadership roles

- high-potential development programs

- leadership pipeline development

- career development frameworks

- Partner with executive leadership and HR Business Partners to ensure strong succession pipelines for key corporate and operational leadership positions ashore.

- Embed talent management practices into performance management and leadership development frameworks.

Leadership Development

- Design and implement leadership development programs supporting both shipboard and shore-based leadership populations.

- Establish a global leadership framework aligned with the company’s values and guest-centric culture.

- Strengthen leadership capabilities in areas such as:

- people leadership

- operational decision-making

- service excellence

- innovation and continuous improvement

- cross-cultural leadership

Your Journey so far

Education

- Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Talent Management, or Organizational Development.

- Significant experience designing and implementing global learning strategies for large, international workforces.

- Proven experience leading talent management and succession planning programs for corporate leadership populations.

- Experience in cruise, hospitality, travel, aviation, or other large service-driven organizations strongly preferred.

- Experience working in highly multicultural and geographically distributed environments.

Key Competences

- Strategic Learning & Capability Development

- Talent Management & Succession Planning (Corporate)

- Service Excellence & Hospitality Culture

- Stakeholder Influence & Executive Partnership

- Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence

- Organizational Development

- Learning Technology & Digital Learning

Your Essentials

- Fluency in English is required; Italian, French, German or other European languages are a plus.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Die Rolle stellt sicher, dass das Unternehmen die Fähigkeiten entwickelt, die erforderlich sind, um außergewöhnliche Gästeerlebnisse, operative Exzellenz und eine starke Führungsrolle in einer globalen Belegschaft zu bieten, darunter Tausende von Schiffsbesatzungen und eine vielfältige landgestützte Organisation.
Für Mitarbeiter an Bord von Schiffen konzentriert sich die Rolle auf den Aufbau von erstklassigen Betriebs- und Servicefähigkeiten durch strukturierte Schulungen, Führungsentwicklung und Karriereentwicklungsrahmen, die die Leistung der Flotte und die Gästezufriedenheit unterstützen.
Für Mitarbeiter an Land führt die Rolle sowohl Learning & Development als auch Talent Management, einschließlich Führungskräfteentwicklung, Nachfolgeplanung und Talentpipeline-Entwicklung für Unternehmens- und operative Führungsrollen.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Führungskräften in den Bereichen Operations, Guest Experience und Corporate Functions treibt diese Rolle eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens, der Exzellenz von Führungskräften und des Aufbaus organisatorischer Fähigkeiten in den globalen Aktivitäten des Unternehmens voran.

- Sicherstellen, dass Lerninitiativen strategische Prioritäten direkt unterstützen, wie:

- Gasterlebnis Exzellenz

- Sicherheit und Einhaltung

- Betriebsleistung

- Führungswirksamkeit

- Digitale und Business Transformation

- Führen Sie die Einführung moderner Lernansätze wie digitales Lernen, simulationsbasiertes Training, Microlearning und Blended-Learning-Lösungen an.

Shipboard Learning & Development

- Führen Sie die Gestaltung und Umsetzung der globalen Lern- und Entwicklungsstrategie an Bord der gesamten Flotte.

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Führung von Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage und Guest Experience, um sicherzustellen, dass Schulungsprogramme die operativen Prioritäten und Service-Exzellenz unterstützen.

- Gewährleistung einheitlicher Ausbildungsstandards für die gesamte Flotte und gleichzeitige Berücksichtigung der betrieblichen Gegebenheiten an Bord.

Landgestütztes Lernen & Entwicklung

- Führen Sie die Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Lern- und Entwicklungsprogrammen für Mitarbeiter an Land in allen Unternehmens- und Betriebsfunktionen.

- Entwicklung von Initiativen zum Aufbau von Fähigkeiten zur Unterstützung wichtiger Geschäftsprioritäten wie:

- kommerzielle Kapazitäten

- Digitale Transformation

- Operative Exzellenz

- Gastzentrierte Kultur

- Entwerfen Sie strukturierte Führungsentwicklungsprogramme für aufstrebende, mittlere und leitende Führungskräfte.

- Entwicklung funktionaler Akademien und Fähigkeitsrahmen, die kritische Unternehmensdisziplinen unterstützen.

- Talentidentifizierung und Talent Reviews

- Nachfolgeplanung für kritische Führungsrollen

- Entwicklungsprogramme mit hohem Potenzial

- Leadership Pipeline Entwicklung

- Laufbahnentwicklungsrahmen

- Einbetten von Talent-Management-Praktiken in Performance-Management und Führungskräfteentwicklung Frameworks.

Führungskräfteentwicklung

- Entwerfen und implementieren Sie Führungsentwicklungsprogramme, die sowohl die Führungsbevölkerung an Bord als auch an Land unterstützen.

- Etablieren Sie einen globalen Führungsrahmen, der sich an den Werten und der gastorientierten Kultur des Unternehmens orientiert.

- Stärkung der Führungskompetenzen in Bereichen wie:

- Menschenführung

- operative Entscheidungsfindung

- Service Excellence

- Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung

- Interkulturelle Führung

- Master-Abschluss in Human Resources, Organisationsentwicklung, Business Administration oder verwandten Bereichen.

Erfahrung

- Bedeutende Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Umsetzung globaler Lernstrategien für große, internationale Arbeitskräfte.

- Bewährte Erfahrung in führenden Talentmanagement- und Nachfolgeplanungsprogrammen für Unternehmensführungsgruppen.

- Stakeholder-Einfluss & Executive Partnership

- Lerntechnologie & Digitales Lernen

Unser Engagement

Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die verschiedene Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. jobs.description:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a high-caliber, dedicated PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager to oversee a strategic infrastructure investment project in the Caribbean, while establishing governance and execution discipline across current and future projects in the investment pipeline.
This role carries full accountability for project delivery, spanning finance, construction, commercial, operational, HR, regulatory, and stakeholder dimensions. The successful candidate will act as the single point of coordination and control between investors, contractors, operators, lenders, and government stakeholders.

Your Impact

• Establish and lead a Project Management System, including governance, reporting, controls, and KPIs.
• Drive end-to-end execution of major infrastructure projects, from development through construction and into operations.
• Oversees construction delivery and project financials, including budgets, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, lender requirements, and reporting.
• Lead commercial and contract management, supplier, and concession PPP agreements.
• Ensure operational readiness and handover, including systems, staffing, and procedures.
• Coordinate HR and workforce planning, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and effective contractor management.
• Identify and manage project risks across technical, financial, regulatory, ESG, and political dimensions.
• Provide PMO oversight and execution support for additional projects in the development funnel.

Your Journey so far

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or real asset projects.
• Demonstrated leadership of complex, capital-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Strong experience across construction, project finance, commercial contracts, and operations.
• Experience in emerging markets and/or the Caribbean region strongly preferred.
• PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification preferred.

Your Essentials

• Hands-on, structured, and highly accountable
• Executive presence and credibility with senior stakeholders
• Comfortable working in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments
• Willing to travel and be on-site as required

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Senior Digital Acquisition Manager will be responsible for leading the digital marketing strategy across all MSC Cruises markets, with a focus on driving direct sales through digital advertising levers, setting and achieving KPIs, and developing innovative digital campaigns across multiple channels. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in performance marketing and digital sales development at a positive ROAS, along with strong expertise in digital advertising campaign strategy, paid media planning and implementation, and team leadership. Additionally, the role will involve developing affiliation and partnership programs as part of an integrated digital engagement strategy to broaden reach, drive qualified traffic, and support long-term customer value.

Your Impact

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with MSC stakeholders across various markets, with a deep understanding of their business needs, challenges, and opportunities—while balancing the global objectives set by headquarters.

• Set and achieve KPIs for online sales through digital advertising levers, ensuring the media agency delivers against targets and contractual obligations.

• Lead internal meetings, QBRs, and annual reviews by providing strategic insights and recommendations based on campaign performance, website analytics, market trends, and the competitive landscape.

• Plan and implement innovative performance marketing campaigns across Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio, and Video channels—tailored to business goals and market dynamics.

• Collaborate with internal teams—including Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product, and agency partners—to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality assets aligned with annual digital sales targets.

• Identify and pursue opportunities to enhance revenue streams through existing and new digital strategies, while improving campaign ROAS and experimenting with innovations in the adtech and martech ecosystem.

• Develop and manage lead generation strategies, ensuring effective customer acquisition flows and nurturing tactics are in place across all paid media touchpoints.

• Maintain oversight of account resourcing and profitability to ensure HQ and local markets are managed efficiently and profitably.

• Serve as the main escalation point for concerns raised by internal teams or local market stakeholders.

• Continuously review and optimize operational workflows, proposing and implementing process improvements where relevant.

• Collaborate with country and HQ stakeholders to prepare and manage the annual digital marketing budget, aligned with MSC Cruises’ B2C revenue goals.

• Lead and optimize affiliate and partnership programs to drive qualified traffic and conversions, ensuring alignment with digital acquisition strategy and performance goals.

• Manage key partners and co-branded initiatives, coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and tracking.

Your Journey so far

• 7+ years of experience in a similar role.
• Hands-on experience with analytics and ad server tools such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager and their relevant reporting frameworks.
• Proven experience in managing, mentoring, and upskilling team members.
• Past experience in lead generation strategy and execution is a strong plus.
• Solid experience in budget ownership and cost control.

Your Essentials

• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to leverage data for informed decision-making.
• Proven track record of driving direct sales growth and improving ROAS through high-performing digital advertising campaigns.
• Passion for digital marketing, performance media, and innovative digital solutions.
• Deep knowledge of Google and Meta ad platforms, including setup auditing, implementation, and performance analysis with actionable insights.
• Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and data visualization tools such as Datorama.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and external partners.
• Ability to identify trends in data and transform insights into actionable strategic recommendations.
• Self-starter with the ability to work independently and take initiative.
• Confident, articulate presenter—comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
• Strong strategic thinking, capable of acting as a ‘Trusted Advisor’ to senior leadership.
• High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Positive attitude, proactive mindset, and a drive to embrace new challenges.
• Knowledge of affiliate platforms such as Awin, Kwanko, and similar tools. Strong network of industry contacts to initiate partnership opportunities and brand collaborations.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Votre but

Le responsable principal de l'acquisition numérique sera chargé de diriger la stratégie de marketing numérique sur tous les marchés de MSC Cruises, en mettant l'accent sur la promotion des ventes directes par le biais de leviers publicitaires numériques, la mise en place et la réalisation de KPI, et le développement de campagnes numériques innovantes sur plusieurs canaux. Le candidat retenu aura une expérience éprouvée en marketing de performance et en développement de ventes numériques à un ROAS positif, ainsi qu'une solide expertise dans la stratégie de campagne publicitaire numérique, la planification et la mise en oeuvre des médias rémunérés et le leadership d'équipe. De plus, le rôle consistera à élaborer des programmes d'affiliation et de partenariat dans le cadre d'une stratégie intégrée d'engagement numérique visant à élargir la portée, à stimuler le trafic qualifié et à soutenir la valeur à long terme des clients.

Votre impact

• Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les intervenants du SMC sur divers marchés, en ayant une compréhension approfondie de leurs besoins opérationnels, de leurs défis et de leurs possibilités, tout en conciliant les objectifs mondiaux fixés par l'Administration centrale.

• Définir et réaliser des KPI pour les ventes en ligne au moyen de leviers publicitaires numériques, en veillant à ce que l'agence de presse respecte les objectifs et les obligations contractuelles.

• Diriger les réunions internes, les RAQ et les examens annuels en fournissant des renseignements et des recommandations stratégiques fondés sur le rendement de la campagne, l'analyse du site Web, les tendances du marché et le paysage concurrentiel.

• Planifier et mettre en oeuvre des campagnes de marketing de performance innovatrices sur les canaux payants de recherche, d'affichage, social, autochtone, audio numérique et vidéo, adaptées aux objectifs commerciaux et à la dynamique du marché.

• Collaborer avec des équipes internes – y compris Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product et agences partenaires – afin d'assurer la livraison en temps opportun d'actifs de haute qualité alignés sur les objectifs annuels de ventes numériques.

• Identifier et exploiter les occasions d'accroître les flux de revenus grâce aux stratégies numériques existantes et nouvelles, tout en améliorant le ROAS de la campagne et en expérimentant les innovations dans l'écosystème adtech et martech.

• Élaborer et gérer des stratégies de production de plomb, en veillant à ce que les flux d'acquisition et les tactiques d'encouragement des clients soient efficaces dans tous les points de contact des médias payants.

• Maintenir la surveillance du renouvellement des comptes et de la rentabilité pour s'assurer que l'administration centrale et les marchés locaux sont gérés de façon efficiente et rentable.

• Servir de principal point d'escalade pour les préoccupations soulevées par les équipes internes ou les acteurs du marché local.

• Examiner et optimiser en permanence les flux de travail opérationnels, proposer et mettre en œuvre des améliorations de processus le cas échéant.

• Collaborer avec les intervenants du pays et de l'AC pour préparer et gérer le budget annuel de marketing numérique, en harmonie avec les objectifs de recettes B2C de MSC Cruises.

• Diriger et optimiser les programmes d'affiliation et de partenariat pour stimuler le trafic qualifié et les conversions, en assurant l'alignement avec la stratégie d'acquisition numérique et les objectifs de performance.

• Gérer les principaux partenaires et les initiatives co-marquées, en coordination avec les équipes internes afin d'assurer une exécution et un suivi transparents.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

• 7 ans et plus d'expérience dans un rôle similaire.
• Expérience pratique avec les outils d'analyse et de serveur publicitaire tels que GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager et leurs cadres de rapport pertinents.
• Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion, le mentorat et le perfectionnement des membres de l'équipe.
• L'expérience passée en matière de stratégie et d'exécution de la génération de plomb est un plus fort.
• Une solide expérience en matière de propriété budgétaire et de contrôle des coûts.

Vos essentiels

• Fluent en anglais (les langues supplémentaires sont un plus).
• De solides compétences analytiques et la capacité de tirer parti des données pour prendre des décisions éclairées.
• Expérience éprouvée de la croissance des ventes directes et de l'amélioration du ROAS grâce à des campagnes publicitaires numériques à haut rendement.
• Passion pour le marketing numérique, les médias de performance et les solutions numériques innovantes.
• Connaissance approfondie des plateformes publicitaires Google et Meta, y compris l'audit de configuration, la mise en œuvre et l'analyse des performances avec des idées pratiques.
• Excellente capacité d'organisation, de gestion de projet et de résolution de problèmes.
• Compétence en Microsoft Office et outils de visualisation des données tels que Datorama.
• Forte capacité de collaboration et de communication, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre les équipes interfonctionnelles et les partenaires externes.
• Capacité d'identifier les tendances des données et de transformer les idées en recommandations stratégiques réalisables.
• Auto-démarrer avec la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et prendre des initiatives.
• Confident, articulant présentateur — engagement confortable avec les intervenants supérieurs et les équipes internes.
• Une pensée stratégique forte, capable d'agir comme «Conseiller fiable» auprès des cadres supérieurs.
• Une grande attention au détail et la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement dynamique et rapide.
• Une attitude positive, une attitude proactive et une volonté de relever de nouveaux défis.
• Connaissance des plateformes d'affiliation comme Awin, Kwanko et des outils similaires. Un réseau solide de contacts avec l'industrie pour lancer des possibilités de partenariat et des collaborations de marque.

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique.
